programs.title: Where the Wild Men Are UK
programs.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle travels around the British Isles in search of people who gave up living in big cities and moved to the provinces to be closer to nature.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The creators of the series present the everyday life of a group of daredevils struggling with wildlife in various regions of northern Canada during a frosty winter.Johnatan Granier will join the program in the second season.

programs.title: Inside the Factory
programs.desc: The presenters visit the largest factories in the world and reveal the behind-the-scenes of the creation of popular products, normally inaccessible to ordinary consumers.

programs.title: Life Below Zero
programs.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.
